slug: 2024-01-01 Gambia National Digital Identity Strategy (Strategy Report)

systems.country_label: Digital Birth certificate; Digitized Birth Certificate
systems.tiers: Initiated in the last quarter of 2022; its own 10-digit certificate number; no data synchronisation with the Immigration Department

systems.platform: Semlex biometric system, on a public-private partnership
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Department of Immigration
systems.tiers: Registration centres connected to data centres; biometric ID card issued from October 2018

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication and Digital Economy
systems.tiers: Proposed; registration centres planned; costed at USD 22.24 million

systems.system: Registration at birth for integration with the CRVS system
systems.tiers: Proposed feature of the Digital ID programme

note: Read from the artefact PDF. No fact: the report, dated 27 April and 24 October 2023 on its cover, is a UNECA-drafted identity strategy, and says of civil registration only that a digital birth certificate under the Ministry of Health was initiated in the last quarter of 2022, without saying what system makes the record or where; it does not name the eCRVS.
